---
title: "Adivina la brecha: ¿quién participa más?"
subtitle: "Un mini-juego con medidor sobre la brecha de género en tareas domésticas — ENUT Chile 2023"
toc: true
---

Segunda vuelta del juego, con otra mecánica: esta vez adivinas una **diferencia en puntos porcentuales** — cuántos puntos más (o menos) de mujeres, comparado con hombres, realizaron cada tarea doméstica en un día típico — moviendo la aguja de un medidor. Ojo: en algunas tareas son los hombres quienes participan más, así que la aguja puede apuntar hacia cualquiera de los dos lados.

::: {.callout-note}
## Fuente de los datos
Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas (INE) de Chile, **II Encuesta Nacional sobre Uso del Tiempo (II ENUT) 2023**, personas de 15 años y más, población total. Las tasas de participación son las mismas de la rueda en [Trabajo pago y doméstico](paid-domestic-work.qmd).
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```
```{ojs}
function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = arr.slice();
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
activityList = [...new Set(participationRaw.map(d => d.activity_code))].map(code => {
  const rec = participationRaw.find(d => d.activity_code === code && d.age_tab === "Total");
  return { code, label: rec.activity };
})
function getShare(code, sex) {
  const rec = participationRaw.find(d => d.activity_code === code && d.age_tab === "Total" && d.sex === sex);
  return rec ? rec.share : null;
}
function roundData(code) {
  const shareM = getShare(code, "Mujeres");
  const shareH = getShare(code, "Hombres");
  const gap = Math.round((shareM - shareH) * 100);
  return { code, label: activityList.find(a => a.code === code).label, shareM, shareH, gap };
}
function feedback(errorAbs) {
  if (errorAbs <= 3) return { emoji: "🎯", text: "¡Exacto!" };
  if (errorAbs <= 8) return { emoji: "🔥", text: "Caliente." };
  if (errorAbs <= 15) return { emoji: "🌤️", text: "Tibio." };
  return { emoji: "🥶", text: "Frío — bastante lejos." };
}
function fmtPP(v) {
  const r = Math.round(v);
  return (r > 0 ? "+" : "") + r + " pp";
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gaugeGame = {
  const GMIN = -30, GMAX = 30;
  const R = 140, width = 2 * R + 60, height = R + 90;
  const cx = width / 2, cy = height - 55;

  function angleFor(v) {
    const t = Math.max(GMIN, Math.min(GMAX, v));
    return ((t - GMIN) / (GMAX - GMIN) - 0.5) * Math.PI;
  }
  function needlePoint(angle, len) {
    return [cx + Math.sin(angle) * len, cy - Math.cos(angle) * len];
  }

  const wrapper = html`<div></div>`;
  const roundBox = html`<div></div>`;
  wrapper.appendChild(roundBox);

  let order = shuffle(activityList.map(a => a.code));
  let roundIndex = 0;
  let results = [];

  function drawGaugeBase(svg) {
    const arcGen = (a0, a1, r0, r1) => d3.arc().innerRadius(r0).outerRadius(r1).startAngle(a0).endAngle(a1)();
    const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${cx},${cy})`);
    g.append("path").attr("d", arcGen(-Math.PI / 2, 0, R - 16, R)).attr("fill", colorH).attr("opacity", 0.3);
    g.append("path").attr("d", arcGen(0, Math.PI / 2, R - 16, R)).attr("fill", colorM).attr("opacity", 0.3);
    g.append("path").attr("d", arcGen(-Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, R - 16, R)).attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", "#999").attr("stroke-width", 1);
    // zero tick
    const [zx1, zy1] = [0, -(R - 16)];
    const [zx2, zy2] = [0, -R];
    g.append("line").attr("x1", zx1).attr("y1", zy1).attr("x2", zx2).attr("y2", zy2).attr("stroke", "#666").attr("stroke-width", 2);
    [GMIN, GMIN / 2, 0, GMAX / 2, GMAX].forEach(v => {
      const a = angleFor(v);
      const [tx, ty] = needlePoint(a, R + 14);
      g.append("text").attr("x", tx - cx).attr("y", ty - cy).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 10).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(v > 0 ? `+${v}` : `${v}`);
    });
    g.append("text").attr("x", -R - 10).attr("y", 14).attr("text-anchor", "start").attr("font-size", 11).attr("fill", colorH).text("← Hombres");
    g.append("text").attr("x", R + 10).attr("y", 14).attr("text-anchor", "end").attr("font-size", 11).attr("fill", colorM).text("Mujeres →");
    return g;
  }

  function renderRound() {
    roundBox.innerHTML = "";
    const code = order[roundIndex];
    const data = roundData(code);

    const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); text-align:center;"></div>`;

    const progress = html`<div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #666); margin-bottom: 4px;">Ronda ${roundIndex + 1} de ${order.length}</div>`;
    const iconLine = html`<div style="font-size: 2.2rem;">${activityIcons[code] || "•"}</div>`;
    const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">${data.label}</div>`;
    const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 12px; max-width: 480px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">¿Cuántos <strong>puntos porcentuales más</strong> (o menos) de <span style="color:${colorM}; font-weight:700;">mujeres</span>, comparado con <span style="color:${colorH}; font-weight:700;">hombres</span>, realizaron esta tarea en un día típico? Mueve la aguja.</div>`;

    const gaugeHolder = html`<div></div>`;
    const svg = d3.select(gaugeHolder).append("svg").attr("width", width).attr("height", height).attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`).style("max-width", "100%");
    const g = drawGaugeBase(svg);
    const needle = g.append("line").attr("x1", 0).attr("y1", 0).attr("x2", 0).attr("y2", -(R - 24)).attr("stroke", "#333").attr("stroke-width", 3).attr("stroke-linecap", "round");
    g.append("circle").attr("r", 5).attr("fill", "#333");
    const readout = svg.append("text").attr("x", cx).attr("y", cy - R * 0.45).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 22).attr("font-weight", 700).attr("fill", "currentColor").text("0 pp");

    let guessVal = 0;
    function setNeedle(v) {
      const a = angleFor(v);
      const [nx, ny] = needlePoint(a, R - 24);
      needle.attr("x2", nx - cx).attr("y2", ny - cy);
      readout.text(fmtPP(v));
    }
    setNeedle(0);

    const slider = html`<input type="range" min="${GMIN}" max="${GMAX}" step="1" value="0" style="width: 100%; max-width: 420px;">`;
    slider.oninput = () => { guessVal = +slider.value; setNeedle(guessVal); };

    const submitBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top: 16px;">Comprobar</button>`;

    card.appendChild(progress);
    card.appendChild(iconLine);
    card.appendChild(group);
    card.appendChild(question);
    card.appendChild(gaugeHolder);
    card.appendChild(slider);
    card.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
    card.appendChild(submitBtn);
    roundBox.appendChild(card);

    submitBtn.onclick = () => {
      results.push({ code, label: data.label, guess: guessVal, actual: data.gap, shareM: data.shareM, shareH: data.shareH });
      renderReveal(data, guessVal, g, needle, readout);
    };
  }

  function renderReveal(data, guess, g, needle, readout) {
    const card = roundBox.querySelector("div");
    // disable slider/button, add real needle + feedback
    const slider = card.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
    const submitBtn = card.querySelector("button");
    if (slider) slider.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.remove();

    const errorAbs = Math.abs(guess - data.gap);
    const fb = feedback(errorAbs);
    const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 12px 0;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Adivinaste <strong>${fmtPP(guess)}</strong>, el valor real es <strong>${fmtPP(data.gap)}</strong> (te desviaste por ${errorAbs} pp).</div>`;

    // grey out guess needle, animate a new accent needle to the real value
    needle.attr("stroke", "#aaa").attr("stroke-width", 2).attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,2");
    readout.attr("fill", "#aaa");

    function angleFor(v) {
      const GMIN = -30, GMAX = 30;
      return ((v - GMIN) / (GMAX - GMIN) - 0.5) * Math.PI;
    }
    const R = 140;
    function needlePointLocal(angle, len) {
      return [Math.sin(angle) * len, -Math.cos(angle) * len];
    }
    const realNeedle = g.append("line").attr("x1", 0).attr("y1", 0)
      .attr("x2", 0).attr("y2", -(R - 24))
      .attr("stroke", accentColor).attr("stroke-width", 3.5).attr("stroke-linecap", "round");
    g.append("circle").attr("r", 4).attr("fill", accentColor);

    realNeedle.transition().duration(700).attrTween("x2", () => {
      const interp = d3.interpolateNumber(angleFor(guess), angleFor(data.gap));
      return t => needlePointLocal(interp(t), R - 24)[0];
    }).attrTween("y2", () => {
      const interp = d3.interpolateNumber(angleFor(guess), angleFor(data.gap));
      return t => needlePointLocal(interp(t), R - 24)[1];
    });

    // context bars
    const barsHolder = html`<div style="margin-top: 16px; text-align:left; max-width: 420px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;"></div>`;
    const barsSvg = d3.select(barsHolder).append("svg").attr("width", 420).attr("height", 80).attr("viewBox", "0 0 420 80");
    const rows = [
      { label: "Mujeres", share: data.shareM, color: colorM, y: 8 },
      { label: "Hombres", share: data.shareH, color: colorH, y: 44 }
    ];
    rows.forEach(r => {
      barsSvg.append("text").attr("x", 0).attr("y", r.y + 15).attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(r.label);
      barsSvg.append("rect").attr("x", 80).attr("y", r.y).attr("width", 4).attr("height", 22).attr("fill", "#ddd");
      barsSvg.append("rect").attr("x", 80).attr("y", r.y).attr("width", r.share * 260).attr("height", 22).attr("fill", r.color).attr("rx", 3);
      barsSvg.append("text").attr("x", 86 + r.share * 260).attr("y", r.y + 15).attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(`${Math.round(r.share * 100)}%`);
    });

    const nextBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:16px;">${roundIndex + 1 < order.length ? "Siguiente ronda →" : "Ver resultado final"}</button>`;
    nextBtn.onclick = () => {
      if (roundIndex + 1 < order.length) {
        roundIndex += 1;
        renderRound();
      } else {
        renderSummary();
      }
    };

    card.appendChild(fbBox);
    card.appendChild(barsHolder);
    card.appendChild(nextBtn);
  }

  function renderSummary() {
    roundBox.innerHTML = "";
    const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent);"></div>`;

    const title = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 16px;">Resultado final</div>`;

    const table = html`<table style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px;"></table>`;
    const thead = html`<thead><tr>
      <th style="text-align:left; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #999;">Tarea</th>
      <th style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #999;">Tu respuesta</th>
      <th style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #999;">Real</th>
      <th style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #999;">Diferencia</th>
    </tr></thead>`;
    table.appendChild(thead);
    const tbody = html`<tbody></tbody>`;
    let totalError = 0;
    results.forEach(r => {
      const err = Math.abs(r.guess - r.actual);
      totalError += err;
      const row = html`<tr>
        <td style="padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">${activityIcons[r.code] || ""} ${r.label}</td>
        <td style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">${fmtPP(r.guess)}</td>
        <td style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">${fmtPP(r.actual)}</td>
        <td style="text-align:right; padding:6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;">${err} pp</td>
      </tr>`;
      tbody.appendChild(row);
    });
    table.appendChild(tbody);

    const avgError = Math.round((totalError / results.length) * 10) / 10;
    const closing = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">Tu error promedio fue de <strong>${avgError} pp</strong> por ronda. ${avgError <= 5 ? "Excelente calibración." : avgError <= 12 ? "Una intuición razonable, aunque algunas tareas sorprenden." : "La brecha real varía más de lo que la mayoría intuye, tarea por tarea."}</div>`;

    const replayBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;">Jugar de nuevo</button>`;
    replayBtn.onclick = () => {
      order = shuffle(activityList.map(a => a.code));
      roundIndex = 0;
      results = [];
      renderRound();
    };

    card.appendChild(title);
    card.appendChild(table);
    card.appendChild(closing);
    card.appendChild(replayBtn);
    roundBox.appendChild(card);
  }

  renderRound();
  return wrapper;
}
```

::: {.callout-important}
"Mantenimiento del hogar" es la única tarea de esta lista donde los hombres participan más que las mujeres — todas las demás muestran brechas a favor de una mayor participación femenina, aunque de magnitudes muy distintas. Revisa la rueda interactiva en [Trabajo pago y doméstico](paid-domestic-work.qmd) para el detalle completo.
:::

## Prueba otros estilos

El medidor de arriba es solo una forma de adivinar. Aquí tienes tres más, cada una con una tarea al azar — prueba varias y quédate con la que más te guste.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function randomActivityCode() {
  return activityList[Math.floor(Math.random() * activityList.length)].code;
}
function contextBarsSvg(shareM, shareH) {
  const holder = html`<div style="margin-top: 16px; text-align:left; max-width: 380px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;"></div>`;
  const svg = d3.select(holder).append("svg").attr("width", 380).attr("height", 80).attr("viewBox", "0 0 380 80");
  const rows = [
    { label: "Mujeres", share: shareM, color: colorM, y: 8 },
    { label: "Hombres", share: shareH, color: colorH, y: 44 }
  ];
  rows.forEach(r => {
    svg.append("text").attr("x", 0).attr("y", r.y + 15).attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(r.label);
    svg.append("rect").attr("x", 80).attr("y", r.y).attr("width", 4).attr("height", 22).attr("fill", "#ddd");
    svg.append("rect").attr("x", 80).attr("y", r.y).attr("width", r.share * 220).attr("height", 22).attr("fill", r.color).attr("rx", 3);
    svg.append("text").attr("x", 86 + r.share * 220).attr("y", r.y + 15).attr("font-size", 12).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(`${Math.round(r.share * 100)}%`);
  });
  return holder;
}
function retryButton(container, buildFn) {
  const btn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:16px;">Otra tarea →</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => { container.innerHTML = ""; buildFn(container); };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function buildLineDemo(container) {
  const code = randomActivityCode();
  const data = roundData(code);
  const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); text-align:center;"></div>`;

  const iconLine = html`<div style="font-size: 2.2rem;">${activityIcons[code] || "•"}</div>`;
  const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">${data.label}</div>`;
  const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 16px; max-width: 480px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">¿Cuántos <strong>puntos porcentuales más</strong> (o menos) de <span style="color:${colorM}; font-weight:700;">mujeres</span> que <span style="color:${colorH}; font-weight:700;">hombres</span> hicieron esta tarea? Arrastra el marcador.</div>`;

  const GMIN = -30, GMAX = 30;
  const width = 560, height = 70, x0 = 30, x1 = width - 30;
  const scale = v => x0 + ((v - GMIN) / (GMAX - GMIN)) * (x1 - x0);

  const lineHolder = html`<div style="overflow-x:auto;"></div>`;
  const svg = d3.select(lineHolder).append("svg").attr("width", width).attr("height", height).attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`).style("max-width", "100%");
  svg.append("rect").attr("x", x0).attr("y", 40).attr("width", (x1 - x0) / 2).attr("height", 6).attr("fill", colorH).attr("opacity", 0.3);
  svg.append("rect").attr("x", scale(0)).attr("y", 40).attr("width", (x1 - x0) / 2).attr("height", 6).attr("fill", colorM).attr("opacity", 0.3);
  svg.append("line").attr("x1", x0).attr("x2", x1).attr("y1", 43).attr("y2", 43).attr("stroke", "#999").attr("stroke-width", 1);
  [GMIN, GMIN / 2, 0, GMAX / 2, GMAX].forEach(v => {
    const x = scale(v);
    svg.append("line").attr("x1", x).attr("x2", x).attr("y1", 38).attr("y2", 48).attr("stroke", "#999");
    svg.append("text").attr("x", x).attr("y", 64).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 10).attr("fill", "currentColor").text(fmtPP(v));
  });
  const marker = svg.append("circle").attr("cy", 43).attr("r", 7).attr("fill", "#333").attr("cx", scale(0));
  const readout = svg.append("text").attr("x", scale(0)).attr("y", 24).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 13).attr("font-weight", 700).attr("fill", "currentColor").text("0 pp");

  let guessVal = 0;
  const slider = html`<input type="range" min="${GMIN}" max="${GMAX}" step="1" value="0" style="width: 100%; max-width: 480px;">`;
  slider.oninput = () => {
    guessVal = +slider.value;
    marker.attr("cx", scale(guessVal));
    readout.attr("x", scale(guessVal)).text(fmtPP(guessVal));
  };

  const submitBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:16px;">Comprobar</button>`;

  card.appendChild(iconLine);
  card.appendChild(group);
  card.appendChild(question);
  card.appendChild(lineHolder);
  card.appendChild(slider);
  card.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
  card.appendChild(submitBtn);
  container.appendChild(card);

  submitBtn.onclick = () => {
    slider.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.remove();
    const errorAbs = Math.abs(guessVal - data.gap);
    const fb = feedback(errorAbs);
    const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 12px 0;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Adivinaste <strong>${fmtPP(guessVal)}</strong>, el valor real es <strong>${fmtPP(data.gap)}</strong> (te desviaste por ${errorAbs} pp).</div>`;
    marker.attr("fill", "#aaa");
    readout.attr("fill", "#aaa");
    const realMarker = svg.append("circle").attr("cy", 43).attr("r", 7).attr("fill", accentColor).attr("cx", scale(guessVal));
    realMarker.transition().duration(700).attr("cx", scale(data.gap));
    const bars = contextBarsSvg(data.shareM, data.shareH);
    card.appendChild(fbBox);
    card.appendChild(bars);
    card.appendChild(retryButton(container, buildLineDemo));
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function buildSeesawDemo(container) {
  const code = randomActivityCode();
  const data = roundData(code);
  const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); text-align:center;"></div>`;

  const iconLine = html`<div style="font-size: 2.2rem;">${activityIcons[code] || "•"}</div>`;
  const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">${data.label}</div>`;
  const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 16px; max-width: 480px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">¿Quién participó más en esta tarea, y por cuántos puntos porcentuales? Inclina la balanza.</div>`;

  const GMIN = -30, GMAX = 30, MAXTILT = 20;
  const width = 420, height = 220;
  const pivotX = width / 2, pivotY = 150, beamHalf = 140;

  const holder = html`<div></div>`;
  const svg = d3.select(holder).append("svg").attr("width", width).attr("height", height).attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`).style("max-width", "100%");
  svg.append("path").attr("d", `M ${pivotX - 16},${pivotY + 40} L ${pivotX + 16},${pivotY + 40} L ${pivotX},${pivotY} Z`).attr("fill", "#999");
  svg.append("line").attr("x1", pivotX).attr("y1", pivotY + 40).attr("x2", pivotX).attr("y2", pivotY + 56).attr("stroke", "#999").attr("stroke-width", 4);

  const beamGroup = svg.append("g");
  beamGroup.append("line").attr("x1", pivotX - beamHalf).attr("y1", pivotY).attr("x2", pivotX + beamHalf).attr("y2", pivotY).attr("stroke", "#8a6d4a").attr("stroke-width", 8).attr("stroke-linecap", "round");
  beamGroup.append("text").attr("x", pivotX - beamHalf).attr("y", pivotY - 14).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 28).text("👨");
  beamGroup.append("text").attr("x", pivotX + beamHalf).attr("y", pivotY - 14).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 28).text("👩");
  beamGroup.append("circle").attr("cx", pivotX).attr("cy", pivotY).attr("r", 5).attr("fill", "#333");

  function angleFor(v) {
    const t = Math.max(GMIN, Math.min(GMAX, v));
    return (t / GMAX) * MAXTILT;
  }
  function setTilt(v) {
    beamGroup.attr("transform", `rotate(${angleFor(v)} ${pivotX} ${pivotY})`);
  }
  setTilt(0);

  const readout = html`<div style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 8px;">0 pp</div>`;

  let guessVal = 0;
  const slider = html`<input type="range" min="${GMIN}" max="${GMAX}" step="1" value="0" style="width: 100%; max-width: 420px;">`;
  slider.oninput = () => {
    guessVal = +slider.value;
    setTilt(guessVal);
    readout.textContent = fmtPP(guessVal);
  };

  const submitBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:16px;">Comprobar</button>`;

  card.appendChild(iconLine);
  card.appendChild(group);
  card.appendChild(question);
  card.appendChild(holder);
  card.appendChild(readout);
  card.appendChild(slider);
  card.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
  card.appendChild(submitBtn);
  container.appendChild(card);

  submitBtn.onclick = () => {
    slider.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.remove();
    const errorAbs = Math.abs(guessVal - data.gap);
    const fb = feedback(errorAbs);
    const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 12px 0;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Adivinaste <strong>${fmtPP(guessVal)}</strong>, el valor real es <strong>${fmtPP(data.gap)}</strong> (te desviaste por ${errorAbs} pp).</div>`;
    beamGroup.transition().duration(900).attrTween("transform", () => {
      const interp = d3.interpolateNumber(angleFor(guessVal), angleFor(data.gap));
      return t => `rotate(${interp(t)} ${pivotX} ${pivotY})`;
    });
    readout.textContent = fmtPP(data.gap);
    readout.style.color = accentColor;
    const bars = contextBarsSvg(data.shareM, data.shareH);
    card.appendChild(fbBox);
    card.appendChild(bars);
    card.appendChild(retryButton(container, buildSeesawDemo));
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function buildThermoDemo(container) {
  const code = randomActivityCode();
  const data = roundData(code);
  const card = html`<div style="max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); text-align:center;"></div>`;

  const iconLine = html`<div style="font-size: 2.2rem;">${activityIcons[code] || "•"}</div>`;
  const group = html`<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px;">${data.label}</div>`;
  const question = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 16px; max-width: 480px; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;">Estima el <strong>% de mujeres</strong> y el <strong>% de hombres</strong> que hicieron esta tarea en un día típico — la brecha se calcula sola.</div>`;

  const row = html`<div style="display:flex; gap: 40px; justify-content:center; align-items:flex-end; margin-bottom: 12px;"></div>`;

  function verticalSlider(label, color) {
    const col = html`<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px;"></div>`;
    const valLabel = html`<div style="font-weight:700; color:${color};">50%</div>`;
    const slider = html`<input type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="50">`;
    slider.style.cssText = `-webkit-appearance: slider-vertical; width: 32px; height: 160px; accent-color: ${color};`;
    const nameLabel = html`<div>${label}</div>`;
    col.appendChild(valLabel);
    col.appendChild(slider);
    col.appendChild(nameLabel);
    return { col, slider, valLabel };
  }

  const mCol = verticalSlider("Mujeres", colorM);
  const hCol = verticalSlider("Hombres", colorH);
  row.appendChild(mCol.col);
  row.appendChild(hCol.col);

  const gapReadout = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 12px;">Brecha implícita: <strong>0 pp</strong></div>`;
  function updateGapReadout() {
    const g = (+mCol.slider.value) - (+hCol.slider.value);
    gapReadout.querySelector("strong").textContent = fmtPP(g);
  }
  mCol.slider.oninput = () => { mCol.valLabel.textContent = mCol.slider.value + "%"; updateGapReadout(); };
  hCol.slider.oninput = () => { hCol.valLabel.textContent = hCol.slider.value + "%"; updateGapReadout(); };

  const submitBtn = html`<button style="padding:8px 20px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;background:#5c9e95;color:white;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:8px;">Comprobar</button>`;

  card.appendChild(iconLine);
  card.appendChild(group);
  card.appendChild(question);
  card.appendChild(row);
  card.appendChild(gapReadout);
  card.appendChild(submitBtn);
  container.appendChild(card);

  submitBtn.onclick = () => {
    mCol.slider.disabled = true;
    hCol.slider.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.remove();
    const guessM = +mCol.slider.value, guessH = +hCol.slider.value;
    const guessGap = guessM - guessH;
    const errorAbs = Math.abs(guessGap - data.gap);
    const fb = feedback(errorAbs);
    const fbBox = html`<div style="font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 12px 0;"><span style="font-size:1.4rem;">${fb.emoji}</span> ${fb.text} Tu combinación implica <strong>${fmtPP(guessGap)}</strong>, la brecha real es <strong>${fmtPP(data.gap)}</strong> (te desviaste por ${errorAbs} pp).</div>`;
    const bars = contextBarsSvg(data.shareM, data.shareH);
    card.appendChild(fbBox);
    card.appendChild(bars);
    card.appendChild(retryButton(container, buildThermoDemo));
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
templateGallery = {
  const wrapper = html`<div id="template-gallery"></div>`;
  const tabBar = html`<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom: 16px;"></div>`;
  const demoBox = html`<div></div>`;
  wrapper.appendChild(tabBar);
  wrapper.appendChild(demoBox);

  const templates = [
    { id: "line", label: "Línea numérica", build: buildLineDemo },
    { id: "seesaw", label: "Balanza", build: buildSeesawDemo },
    { id: "thermo", label: "Termómetros", build: buildThermoDemo }
  ];

  let active = "line";
  const buttons = templates.map(t => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.textContent = t.label;
    b.style.cssText = "padding:6px 16px;margin:0 4px 8px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #5c9e95;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.9rem;";
    b.onclick = () => { active = t.id; refresh(); };
    tabBar.appendChild(b);
    return { btn: b, id: t.id };
  });

  function updateButtons() {
    buttons.forEach(({ btn, id }) => {
      const on = id === active;
      btn.style.background = on ? "#5c9e95" : "white";
      btn.style.color = on ? "white" : "#333";
    });
  }

  function refresh() {
    updateButtons();
    demoBox.innerHTML = "";
    templates.find(t => t.id === active).build(demoBox);
  }

  refresh();
  return wrapper;
}
```

## Cómo se hizo esta página

1. Usa los mismos datos que la rueda de [Trabajo pago y doméstico](paid-domestic-work.qmd): la ENUT 2023 de Chile, procesada con [`scripts/build_paid_domestic_clock.py`](https://github.com/vvaldiviamedina/vvaldiviamedina.github.io/blob/main/scripts/build_paid_domestic_clock.py) (o su equivalente en R).
2. A diferencia de [Adivina la brecha: duración](guess-the-gap.qmd) (línea numérica, minutos), el medidor principal de esta página registra la adivinanza con un semicírculo (`d3.arc()`) y una aguja que gira según el valor — pensado para una diferencia que puede ser negativa (cuando los hombres participan más).
3. La sección "Prueba otros estilos" son tres bocetos adicionales de la misma mecánica — línea numérica, balanza y termómetros dobles — para comparar qué interacción se siente mejor antes de fijar una sola en el resto del sitio.
